	<xf:if is="property('xgt_Sv13_tema_editor_etkin') OR property('xgt_Sv13_tema_renk_kontrolleri_etkin')">
	<script>
		(function(){
			var html = document.getElementById('XF');	
			document.querySelectorAll('[data-xgt-editor]').forEach(function(element) {
				element.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
					html.classList.toggle('_modalMenu__acik');
					event.preventDefault();
				});
			});
			<xf:if is="property('xgt_Sv13_tema_renk_kontrolleri_etkin')">
				document.querySelectorAll('._renkKontrolleri span').forEach(function(element) {
					element.addEventListener('click', function() {
						var styleid = html.getAttribute('data-style-id');
						var backgroundClass = this.getAttribute('data-xgtSv13-renk');
						html.setAttribute('data-xgtSv13-renk',backgroundClass);
						localStorage.setItem('xgtSv13Renkler-{$xf.style.style_id}', backgroundClass);
					});
				});
			</xf:if>
			document.querySelectorAll('._kontrolbirimleri__icerik').forEach(function(element) {
				var settingName = element.getAttribute('data-ayar');
				var settingDefault = element.getAttribute('data-varsayinal-ayarlar');
				var settingChoice = localStorage.getItem(settingName);
				if (settingChoice === 'on') {
					element.setAttribute('data-ayar-durumu', 'on');
				} else if (settingChoice === 'off') {
					element.setAttribute('data-ayar-durumu', 'off');
				} else {
					if (settingDefault === 'on') {
						element.setAttribute('data-ayar-durumu', 'on');
					} else {
						element.setAttribute('data-ayar-durumu', 'off');
					}
				}
				element.addEventListener('click', function() {
					var settingStatus = this.getAttribute('data-ayar-durumu');
					if (settingStatus === 'on') {
						html.classList.remove(settingName);
						localStorage.setItem(settingName, 'off');
						this.setAttribute('data-ayar-durumu', 'off');
					} else {
						html.classList.add(settingName);
						localStorage.setItem(settingName, 'on');
						this.setAttribute('data-ayar-durumu', 'on');
					}
				});
			});
		})();	
	</script>
</xf:if></xf:comment>

.p-breadcrumbs
{
	overflow: hidden;
	margin: 0;
	width: 100%;
	line-height: inherit;
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;

	&::before,
	&::after{
		display: none;
	}

	> li
	{
		margin: 0;
		font-size: inherit;
		padding-left: calc(@xgt-breadcrumb-padding * 1px);

		&:first-child{
			border-top-left-radius: var(--xgt-global-radius-s);
			border-bottom-left-radius: var(--xgt-global-radius-s);
		}

		&::before,
		&::after{
			display: none;
		}

		a{
			color: inherit;
			display: block;
			max-width: none;
			margin-left: -15px;
			overflow: visible;
			padding: 0 calc(@xgt-breadcrumb-padding * 1px);
			position: relative;
			text-decoration: none;
			z-index: 1;

			&:hover {
				background: transparent;
				color: @xf-xgt_Sv13_breadcrumb_hover--color;
			}

			&::before,
			&::after {
				border-style: solid;
				border-width: 0;
				border-right-width: 1px;
				border-color: @xf-xgt_Sv13_breadcrumb--border-color;
				box-sizing: border-box;
				box-shadow: inset currentColor -1px 0px 0px 0px;
				color: transparent;
				content: '';
				position: absolute;
				transform-origin: 100% 50%;
				height: 50%;
				width: 100%;
				right: 0;
				z-index: -1;
			}

			html[dir='rtl'] &::before,
			html[dir='rtl'] &::after{
				box-shadow: inset currentColor 1px 0px 0px 0px;
			}

			&::before {
				top: 0;
				transform: skewX(30deg);
			}

			&::after {
				top: 50%;
				transform: skewX(-30deg);
			}

			html[dir='rtl'] &::before {
				transform: skewX(-30deg);
			}

			html[dir='rtl'] &::after {
				transform: skewX(30deg);
			}

			//-- Hover
			&:hover::before,
			&:hover::after{
				background: @xf-xgt_Sv13_breadcrumb_hover--background-color;
			}
			//--- Aktif
			&:active::before,
			&:active::after{
				background:  @xf-xgt_Sv13_breadcrumb_hover--background-color;
				box-shadow: inset currentColor -2px 1px 1px;
				color: rgba(0,0,0,0.05);	
			}

			&:active::after{
				box-shadow: inset currentColor -2px -1px 1px;
			}
		}

		&:first-of-type a::before,
		&:first-of-type a::after{
			width: ~"calc(100% + 20px)";
		}
	}

@xgtFrmIstatistik-avatar     : 33px;
@xgtFrmIstatistik-konu       : 100%;
@xgtFrmIstatistik-forum      : 120px;	 
@xgtFrmIstatistik-cevap      : 70px;
@xgtFrmIstatistik-goruntuleme: 70px;
@xgtFrmIstatistik-zaman      : 90px;

//-- [Graves] Style V13 Düzenlemesi
.xgtForumIstatistik 
{
	._istatistik__icerik {
		padding: calc(@xf-xgt_Sv13_kategori_padding * 1px);	
		<xf:if is="property('xgt_Sv13_blok_head_sinir_etkin')">
			border-top: solid @xf-xgt_Sv13_blok_head_sinir_yukseklik  @xf-xgt_Sv13_blok_head_sinir_renk;
		<xf:else />
			border-top: solid 1px @xf-borderColor;
		</xf:if>	
	}
	.xgtForumIstatistik-tabHeader.block-tabHeader {
		margin-bottom: 5px;
	}
	._xgtIstatistik-satir--konu {padding-top: 9px;}	

	.block-container .block-tabHeader{ padding:0;}

	.block-tabHeader .tabs-tab:hover {
		background: @xf-buttonCtaBg;
	}
}
//-- [Graves] Style V13 Düzenlemesi

body .xgtForumIstatistik { counter-reset: steps !important;}
html .xgtForumIstatistik ._xgtIstatistik--blok
{
	&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb 
	{
		background: @xf-textColor;
		border-radius: 4px;
	}
	&::-moz-scrollbar-track 
	{
		background: @xf-textColor;
		border-radius: 4px;
	}
}
html .xgtForumIstatistik ._xgtIstatistik--blok{
	<xf:if is="property('xgt_Frmistatistik_srollbar') == 'gizle'">
		scrollbar-width: none;
		&::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 0px;}
		&::-moz-scrollbar    { width: 0px;}
	<xf:elseif is="property('xgt_Frmistatistik_srollbar') == 'goster'" />
		scrollbar-width: thin;
		&::-webkit-scrollbar{ width: 1px;}
		&::-moz-scrollbar   { width: 1px;}
	</xf:if>
}
<xf:if is="property('xgt_Frmistatistik_srollbar') == 'gizlegoster'">
	html .xgtForumIstatistik ._xgtIstatistik--blok{
		scrollbar-width: none;
		&::-webkit-scrollbar{ width: 0px;}
		&::-moz-scrollbar   { width: 0px;}
		&:hover
		{
			scrollbar-width: thin;
			&::-webkit-scrollbar{ width: 1px;}
			&::-moz-scrollbar   { width: 1px;}
		}
	}
</xf:if>
	
.xgtForumIstatistik
{	
	&-row
	{
		display: -webkit-box;
		display: -ms-flexbox;
		display: flex;
		flex-wrap: wrap;

		&--sag-s, 
		&--sol-s{
			<xf:if is="property('xgt_Frmistatistik_kullanici_veri_konum') == 'solda'">
				flex: 0 0 20%;
				max-width: 20%;
			<xf:else />
				flex: 0 0 19.9%;
				max-width: 19.9%;
				margin-left: 0.1%;
			</xf:if>
		}
		&--l{
			<xf:if is="property('xgt_Frmistatistik_kullanici_veri_konum') == 'sagda'">
				flex: 0 0 80%;
				max-width: 80%;
		    <xf:else />
				flex: 0 0 79.9%;
				max-width: 79.9%;
				margin-left: 0.1%;
		    </xf:if>
		}
		&--xl{
			flex: 0 0 100%;
			max-width: 100%;	
		}		
	}
    <xf:comment> 4.2.2 Guncellemesi </xf:comment>
	.block-header{
		background: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_blok_header;
		color: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_blok_header_metin;
		border-bottom: none;
	}
	
	._xgtIstatistik--blok{
		max-height: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_maxYukseklik;
		min-height: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_maxYukseklik;
		overflow-y: auto;
		//border-radius: 0px 0px @xf-borderRadiusMedium @xf-borderRadiusMedium;

		&.is-active{
			overflow: hidden;
			height: 0;
			opacity: 0;	
			
			.m-transition(all, -xf-height;);
		}
	}
	
	.block-container{ overflow: hidden; }
	
	.xgtForumIstatistik-tabHeader.block-tabHeader{
		background: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_tab_ap;
		color: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_tab_metin;
		border-bottom: none;
		
		.tabs-tab
		{
			border-right: solid 1px @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_tab_yan_sinir_renk;
			font-size: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_tab_metin_boyut;
			position: relative;
			
			&:not(.is-readonly):hover,
			&:hover{
				background: var(--xgtSv13-renk-grup-ikincil);
				color: var(--xgtSv13-renk-grup-metin);
			}
			
			&.is-active{
				background: var(--xgtSv13-renk-grup-ikincil);
				color: var(--xgtSv13-renk-grup-metin);
				border: none;

				}

		margin: 0;
		list-style: none;
	}

			right: 0;
			top: 0;
		}
	}

		list-style: none;

		</xf:if>
		//-- 1. row ap renk
		&:nth-child(1n){ 
			background: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_icerik_satir1;
			<xf:if is="!property('xgt_Frmistatistik_sinir_altSinirlar_etkin')">
				border-bottom: solid 1px @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_icerik_satir1;
			</xf:if>
		}

				border-bottom: solid 1px @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_icerik_satir2;
			</xf:if>
		}

					font-size: @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_metin_boyutu;

				position: absolute;

			}
		}

			max-width: @xgtFrmIstatistik-konu;

				width: @xgtFrmIstatistik-forum;
				max-width:@xgtFrmIstatistik-forum;

				max-width:calc(@xgtFrmIstatistik-forum + 100px);

			<xf:if is="property('xgt_Frmistatistik_altHeader_metinAlani') == 'ikon'">

			color:  @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_altHeader_metin;
			border-bottom:none;

				&--sira, &--forum, &--cevap, &--goruntuleme, &--zaman, &--sonYazan, &--derece
				{
					color:  @xf-xgt_Frmistatistik_altHeader_metin;
					border-left: none;
					text-align: center;
				}
				
				&--konu { padding-left:5px; }					
				&--hucre i { margin: 0 5px 0 0;}
			}
		}

	const elemHgt1Element = document.querySelector('._xgtIstatistik--blok .is-active');
	if (elemHgt1Element) {
		const elemHgt1 = elemHgt1Element.offsetHeight;
		const sagSBlok = document.querySelector(".xgtForumIstatistik-row--sag-s ._xgtIstatistik--blok");
		const solSBlok = document.querySelector(".xgtForumIstatistik-row--sol-s ._xgtIstatistik--blok");

		if (sagSBlok) {
			sagSBlok.style.height = elemHgt1 + "px";
		}
		if (solSBlok) {
			solSBlok.style.height = elemHgt1 + "px";
		}
	}

	let act = document.querySelector('.dfyButons');
	if (act) {
		let firstListItem = act.querySelector('div');
		if (firstListItem) {
			firstListItem.classList.add('active');	
		}
	}

	let tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.xgtForumIstatistik .tabs-tab'));
	let contents = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dfyButon'));

	const handleClick = (el, btn) => {
		el.preventDefault();

		const elemHgt2Element = document.querySelector('._xgtIstatistik--blok .is-active');
		if (elemHgt2Element) {
			const elemHgt2 = elemHgt2Element.offsetHeight;
			const sagSBlok = document.querySelector(".xgtForumIstatistik-row--sag-s ._xgtIstatistik--blok");
			const solSBlok = document.querySelector(".xgtForumIstatistik-row--sol-s ._xgtIstatistik--blok");

			if (sagSBlok) {
				sagSBlok.style.height = elemHgt2 + "px";
			}
			if (solSBlok) {
				solSBlok.style.height = elemHgt2 + "px";
			}
		}

		var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.xgtForumIstatistik-row--l ._xgtIstatistik-konuListe ._xgtIstatistik-satir:nth-child(n+{{ $xf.options.xgt_dfy_toplam  + 1 + {$xf.options.xgt_dfy_sabit} }})');
		rows.forEach(row => row.style.display = 'none');

		tabs.forEach(node => node.classList.remove('active'));
		el.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
		contents.forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
		btn.classList.add('active');
	}

	tabs.forEach((node, i) => {
		node.addEventListener('click', (el) => handleClick(el, contents[i]));
	});

	let loadMoreBtn = document.querySelector('#dfyButon{$veri_id}');
	let loadItems = {$xf.options.xgt_dfy_tik};
	let currentItem = {$xf.options.xgt_dfy_toplam};

	let yukleIkon = document.querySelector('.yukleIkon');

	if (loadMoreBtn) {
		loadMoreBtn.onclick = () => {
			if (yukleIkon) {
				yukleIkon.style.display = 'inline-block';
			}

			setTimeout(() => {
				const allElements = document.querySelectorAll('#istatistikveri-{$veri_id} ._xgtIstatistik-konuListe ._xgtIstatistik-satir');
				let boxes = [...allElements];
				for (let i = currentItem; i < currentItem + loadItems; i++) {
					if (boxes[i]) {
						boxes[i].style.display = 'table';
					}
				}	

				currentItem += loadItems;
				if (currentItem >= boxes.length) {
					loadMoreBtn.style.display = 'none';
				}
				
				const elemHgt = document.querySelector('._xgtIstatistik--blok .is-active');
				if (elemHgt) {
					const sagSBlok = document.querySelector(".xgtForumIstatistik-row--sag-s ._xgtIstatistik--blok");
					const solSBlok = document.querySelector(".xgtForumIstatistik-row--sol-s ._xgtIstatistik--blok");

					if (sagSBlok) {
						sagSBlok.style.height = elemHgt.offsetHeight + "px";
					}
					if (solSBlok) {
						solSBlok.style.height = elemHgt.offsetHeight + "px";
					}
				}

				if (yukleIkon) {
					yukleIkon.style.display = 'none';
				}
			}, 300);
		}
	}
